scenario: An interpolation body that is a general expression (here an operator body `{c.a + c.b}`) is NOT a valid interp_body: LGRA.2.9.6.1 admits only a slot path or a one-level function call, and LGRA.2.9.6.2 makes an unrecognised body an error. The compiler must reject it with DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_PATH rather than emitting the braces verbatim as literal text (reject-don't-skip). Pin: general-expression interpolation is reserved for v2; the let-bind is the v1 workaround.
rules_ds:
schema Coord scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int key

rule r:
    Coord c
->
    log info "sum is {c.a + c.b}"
